summary: Hughes Network Systems provides Managed SD-WAN connectivity for multi-location hospitality businesses, supporting reservation systems, digital menus/signage, back-office applications, guest Wi-Fi, and IP security monitoring; it is a network-infrastructure vendor, not a POS or payments platform.
Manna Hospitality used Hughes managed services and support to strengthen its strategic technology focus, per a Hughes-published case study.

Hughes has deployed more than 30,000 managed SD-WAN sites across distributed enterprises including retailers, restaurants, convenience stores, and gas stations, and was recognized in 2026 by Gartner, CRN, and Frost & Sullivan, marking its third consecutive recognition as a Managed Network Services Leader.
